title: Facing a Task Unfinished
lyrics_original: That drives us to our knees
We, who rejoice to know Thee
The solemn pledge we owe Thee
To go and make Thee known
With none to heed their crying
For life, and love, and light
We go to all the world
No other name has power to save
We bear the torch that flaming
Fell from the hands of those
To Thee we yield our powers
We go to all the world
No other name has power to save
Forth on Thine errands send us
We go to all the world
No other name has power to save
We go to all the world
No other name has power to save

bible_verses.english: Go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be my witnesses both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the grace of knowing You and the joy of being included in Your great mission. Forgive me for the times I have settled into spiritual comfort while so many still long for hope. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit and grant me bold compassion for those who do not yet know Your name. Send me out today with a heart ready to serve, love, and make Your salvation known. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Looking out at a world still waiting to hear the good news of Jesus can feel overwhelming, yet it calls us back to our knees in humble dependence. We are invited to remember the great privilege we have received: knowing the Savior and sharing His love with others. As we sing these words, let us surrender our comfort and ask the Holy Spirit for renewed passion. God does not send us out in our own strength, but promises His presence every step of the way as we make Him known.
